checks.region: opening matter and table of contents
checks.observation: Telugu title, partial-edition scope statement, review-status disclosure, and six-entry table of contents are legible and visually separated.
Telugu glyph shaping is intact in headings and body text; no tofu, replacement glyphs, or overlapping lines were observed.

The table-of-contents link reaches section 1.4. The union diagram is crisp, centered, captioned, and exposed in the accessibility tree with a descriptive alternative; the same tree exposes all three diagrams.

Inline and display mathematics in sections 1.4 and 1.5 aligns with surrounding prose. The ordered-pair formula, definition panel, exercise panel, and longer Cartesian-product material remain readable without visible clipping at the inspected desktop viewport.

The OLP-0009 disclosure changes from collapsed to expanded, brings its content into the accessibility tree, and presents the canonical English text and MathML in a clearly bounded panel beneath the Telugu unit.
Edition scope, offline/MathML note, source attribution, editable-source link, optional expert-review link, translations hub, DOI lineage, font license, and KaTeX license are legible at the footer.

The browser accessibility tree exposes one level-one title, nested section headings, expandable buttons with state, mathematical expressions, three described images, internal references, and provenance links.

limits: This is a visual and interaction spot check at the observed desktop viewport, not a complete browser-matrix or accessibility-conformance certification.
Responsive and print rules are covered by the deterministic source audit; a narrow mobile viewport was not visually emulated in this browser pass.
This receipt does not claim human or independent linguistic review.
